Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I have devoted myself sincerely by cutting off all attachments except to You
And I have turned my entire being towards You

Arabic text: وَصَرَفْتُ وَجْهِيْ عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى رِفْدِكَ
Translation: And I have turned my face away from those who need Your support

Arabic text: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِيْ عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And I have redirected my requests from those who are not free from needing Your grace

Arabic text: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إِلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ
Translation: And I have realized that a needy person asking from another needy person

Arabic text: سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأْيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ
Translation: Is foolishness in their opinion and a misguidance in their intellect
How many, O my God, have I seen

Arabic text: مِنْ أُنَاسٍ طَلَبُوْا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوْا
Translation: People who sought honor from other than You, only to be humiliated
And sought wealth from other than You, only to become impoverished
And attempted to elevate themselves, only to be lowered
So a wise person learns from witnessing their examples
Guided by his consideration
And directed to the path of correctness by his choice
So You, O my Master
Are, before anyone else who could be asked, the place for my request

Arabic text: وَدُوْنَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوبٍ إِلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي
Translation: And before anyone else who could be sought, the guardian of my need

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الْمَخْصُوصُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ مَدْعُوٍّ بِدَعْوَتِي
Translation: You are exclusively, before anyone who could be called, the recipient of my call
No one shares with You in my hope

Arabic text: وَلَا يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِيْ دُعَائِي
Translation: And no one joins with You in my supplication
And my call does not include anyone alongside You
To You, O my God, belongs the uniqueness of number
And the possession of everlasting power
And the excellence of might and strength
And the highest degree of eminence and elevation
And anyone other than You is limited in their lifespan

Arabic text: مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأْنِهِ
Translation: Overpowered in their affairs, subjugated in their condition
Changing in states, transforming in attributes
You are exalted above similarities and opposites
And You are greater than any comparisons or equals
Glory be to You, there is no god but You
